request.style: English, warm classic soul, rich female vocal with backing singers, Rhodes electric piano, Hammond organ, horn section, bass, laid-back drums, soulful and reassuring, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the night is long and the morning's slow to come
When the news is hard and my heart is going numb
I can't see the whole design, I only hold a thread
But I'm standing on the word the apostle Paul once said

[Chorus]
And we know that in all things
God works for the good of those who love him
Who are called according to his purpose
In all things, in all things

[Verse]
Every closing door and every winding road
Every empty chair and every heavy load
The God who gave his Son for me will not forget me now
So I lay down every worry and I let my spirit bow

[Chorus]
And we know that in all things
God works for the good of those who love him
Who are called according to his purpose
In all things, in all things

[Bridge]
If God is for us, who can be against us
Who will separate us from the love of Christ
In all these things we are more than conquerors
Through him who loved us

[Chorus]
And we know that in all things
God works for the good of those who love him
Who are called according to his purpose
In all things, in all things

[Outro]
Neither death nor life
Nor anything else in all creation
Will be able to separate us
From the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord
